system.name: FlowGrad
system.one_liner: Optimises the output of a pretrained generative ODE by adding per-step control variables to the whole trajectory and back-propagating guidance gradients to them.

content.variant_note: four lettered designs (a) to (d) for steering a generative model with a guidance loss, the proposed one last and marked Ours; (c) and (d) share one unrolled ODE chain
content.argues: FlowGrad adds control variables to every step of the complete frozen ODE and optimises them with gradients from the guidance model, with smaller discretization error and no noised guidance model.
content.subject: Four designs for controlled generation with a guidance loss: GAN inversion, DiffusionCLIP, classifier guidance, FlowGrad

(b) gradient returns to the input side of the shortened ODE (arrowhead under x0^train)

content.reading_order: Starts at (a) top-left, reads each chain left to right, then moves down panel by panel past the grey dashed rules to (d), the longest chain, which holds the only red u symbols and the long blue return arrow.

layout.arrangement_note: Three rows divided by grey dashed horizontal rules: the top row is split by a grey dashed vertical rule into (a) and (b), and (b) is split again by a dark-blue dashed vertical line into Fine-tune and Inference; (c) and (d) each take a full row. Every panel is a left-to-right chain with its title underneath.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw every alternative as the same left-to-right chain, keep one colour per model type across panels, and put the single thing that differs (here the control variables u and the gradient's landing point) in a distinct colour on the proposed design.
lessons.suits: Methods that differ from prior work in where a signal (gradient, control, loss) enters or returns, such as guidance, fine-tuning or inversion variants of one base model.

evidence: Our FlowGrad adds control variables to each time step of the complete ODE trajectory
it adopts a shortened ODE with large discretization error
it needs to train a new guidance model that provides gradient for the noised version of the images

summary: FlowGrad controls the output of a pretrained generative ODE by optimising a guidance loss with gradients. Figure 1 compares four designs drawn in the same grammar, in a three-row grid. (a) GAN inversion sends the guidance gradient back to the latent z of a frozen GAN. (b) DiffusionCLIP fine-tunes a shortened ODE and then runs the complete ODE at inference. (c) Classifier guidance adds the gradient of a noised guidance model at each step of a frozen ODE chain through circled plus nodes. (d) FlowGrad, marked Ours, uses the same frozen chain but adds control variables u at every step and sends the gradient from one guidance box back to them along a long blue arrow. Colour codes model types, blue marks gradients, and red marks Frozen, Fine-tuned and u.
summary_zh: FlowGrad 用梯度控制生成式 ODE 的输出。图对比四种方案：(a) GAN 反演、(b) DiffusionCLIP、(c) 分类器引导、(d) FlowGrad，后者在冻结 ODE 每一步加控制变量 u，蓝色长箭头传回梯度。
